Most Asked Technical & HR Interview Questions

Be confident. Use the STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) method to answer behavioural queries.

"Tell me about yourself" (Technical Fresher Pitch) ▼
Structure your 90-second answer: 1) Who you are & your branch, 2) Your core technical stack (e.g. Java/React/Python), 3) Key project highlight with metrics, 4) Why you are passionate about joining their specific team.
"Explain a challenge you faced during a project" ▼
Pick a real technical obstacle encountered during your internship or mini project (such as API rate limits, database synchronization, or state bugs). Explain how you debugged it systematically and what you learned.
Core Computer Science Topics To Revise ▼
Always thoroughly review: 1) OOP 4 pillars with real world code examples, 2) DBMS Normalization & SQL JOINs, 3) OS Deadlocks & Process vs Threads, 4) Networks TCP 3-way handshake and OSI layers.
